scope: No first-person biographical memories; no unreviewed third-party/canonical rulings. All newly written EN/FR responses are unapproved editorial paraphrases, not papal quotations.

title.en: Why is the Mass a sacrifice?
title.fr: Pourquoi la messe est-elle un sacrifice ?

source.studyProposition: 1912 Q349 expressly asks whether the Mass is the sacrifice of the Cross; Q347–351 elaborate distinct parts of the answer.

title.en: How should I pray and follow Mass?
title.fr: Comment assister pieusement à la messe ?

source.studyProposition: 1912 Q354 expressly asks the most fitting way to attend Mass; Q353 concerns the obligation rather than the manner.

title.en: May I pray the Rosary during Mass?
title.fr: Le chapelet est-il permis pendant la messe ?

source.studyProposition: Rosary during Mass is not established by the abbreviated English index match; consult separate 1905 Catechism source directly.

title.en: What happens at the Consecration?
title.fr: Que se passe-t-il à la consécration ?

source.studyProposition: Q328 asks when bread and wine become Christ's Body and Blood; Q325, Q329 and Q330 give complementary distinctions.

title.en: Why ask Our Lady to intercede with Christ?
title.fr: Pourquoi demander l'intercession de Marie auprès du Christ ?

source.studyProposition: Q433 directly asks whether invoking Mary and saints distrusts Christ's sole mediation; Q430 supports Mary's intercession.

title.en: Why must I confess my sins to a priest?
title.fr: Pourquoi confesser ses péchés à un prêtre ?

source.studyProposition: Christ institutes Penance and authorizes priestly ministry (Q356–357); Q380 concerns absolution.

title.en: How should I examine my conscience?
title.fr: Comment examiner sa conscience avant la confession ?

source.studyProposition: Q359 directly explains how to examine conscience; Q358–360 specify preparation and assessment.

title.en: Is fear of Hell a genuine motive for repentance?
title.fr: La peur de l'enfer peut-elle susciter le repentir ?

source.studyProposition: Q365 explicitly describes imperfect sorrow motivated by fear of penalties; Q361–366 provide distinctions.

title.en: Does forgiveness remove the obligation to restore stolen property?
title.fr: Doit-on restituer ce qui a été volé ?

source.studyProposition: Q205 explicitly asks whether a person can be forgiven while capable but unwilling to make restitution.

title.en: What does Baptism change in the soul?
title.fr: Que produit le baptême dans l'âme ?

source.studyProposition: Q295–296 explicitly ask effects of Baptism and whether it transforms the person.

title.en: What does Confirmation add to Baptism?
title.fr: Que donne la confirmation après le baptême ?

source.studyProposition: Q309 expressly asks how Confirmation makes a Christian strong in faith and virtue.

title.en: How should a Christian keep Sunday holy?
title.fr: Comment un chrétien doit-il sanctifier le dimanche ?

source.studyProposition: Q189 directly describes a feast day's religious instruction, good works and rest beyond Mass.

title.en: What graces and duties belong to Christian marriage?
title.fr: Quels dons et quels devoirs comporte le mariage chrétien ?

source.studyProposition: Q406 describes matrimonial sacramental grace and Q413 mutual duties; exclude suspect anachronistic civil-effect questions 409–410.

title.en: Why does Christ call those who suffer blessed?
title.fr: Pourquoi le Christ proclame-t-il bienheureux ceux qui souffrent ?

source.studyProposition: Q265 directly asks why the afflicted can be called blessed contrary to worldly opinion.

title.en: Why is Christian marriage indissoluble?
title.fr: Pourquoi le mariage chrétien est-il indissoluble ?

source.studyProposition: Q406 explicitly teaches the indissoluble matrimonial union; Q409 is a historically contaminated civil-law witness not used here.

title.en: How can God be three Persons and one God?
title.fr: Comment Dieu peut-il être trois Personnes et un seul Dieu ?

source.studyProposition: Q38–40 and 48 explicitly address three distinct Persons in the one divine substance and why this exceeds understanding.

title.en: How can Jesus Christ be God and man?
title.fr: Comment Jésus-Christ est-il à la fois Dieu et homme ?

source.studyProposition: Q78–79 explicitly address two natures in the one divine Person of Christ.

title.en: Why are Scripture and Apostolic Tradition both necessary?
title.fr: Pourquoi l'Écriture et la Tradition apostolique sont-elles nécessaires ?

source.studyProposition: Q233–236 explicitly teach that revelation is preserved in Scripture and Tradition and interpreted authoritatively.

title.en: Why did Christ establish a visible Church?
title.fr: Pourquoi le Christ a-t-il fondé une Église visible ?

source.locus: Salzano manuscript Q255–262; 1905 Catechismo maggiore Q143–153
source.studyProposition: Q105–106 define visible membership and Christ's foundation of the Church.

title.en: How do we recognise the Church founded by Christ?
title.fr: Comment reconnaît-on l'Église fondée par le Christ ?

source.studyProposition: Q107–111 articulate the four marks used to identify the Church.

title.en: Why does the Church need Pope and bishops?
title.fr: Pourquoi l'Église a-t-elle besoin du pape et des évêques ?

source.locus: Salzano manuscript Q256–262; 1905 Catechismo maggiore Q192–209
source.studyProposition: Q112–114 describe pope, bishops and visible teaching authority.

title.en: Does papal infallibility mean the Pope cannot err?
title.fr: L'infaillibilité pontificale signifie-t-elle que le pape ne se trompe jamais ?

source.studyProposition: Q116 directly restricts papal infallibility to defining faith or moral teaching as pastor and teacher of all Christians.

title.en: Can someone outside visible Catholic communion be saved?
title.fr: Une personne hors de la communion catholique visible peut-elle être sauvée ?

source.studyProposition: Q132 explicitly addresses people outside visible communion without personal fault; Q117 handles a separate question about church identity.

title.en: Do the sacraments confer grace or merely symbolize it?
title.fr: Les sacrements donnent-ils la grâce ou la représentent-ils seulement ?

source.studyProposition: Q268 directly says sacraments both signify and actually confer grace.

title.en: What happens through Holy Orders?
title.fr: Que se passe-t-il dans le sacrement de l'ordre ?

source.studyProposition: Q397 directly states the sacred power and indelible character conferred by Holy Orders; historical rite particulars in Q398 require separate dating.

title.en: Why receive Extreme Unction before death is imminent?
title.fr: Pourquoi ne pas attendre la dernière minute pour recevoir l'extrême-onction ?

source.studyProposition: Q396 explicitly recommends administering Extreme Unction while the sick person remains conscious in dangerous illness.

title.en: Will our bodies rise again?
title.fr: Nos corps ressusciteront-ils vraiment ?

source.locus: Salzano manuscript Q299; 1905 Catechismo maggiore Q239–245
source.studyProposition: Q157–158 directly describe bodily resurrection and reuniting body and soul.

title.en: What is the happiness of Heaven?
title.fr: En quoi consiste le bonheur du Ciel ?

source.studyProposition: Q14 and Q159 identify eternal enjoyment and vision of God as Heaven's happiness.

title.en: Why is Purgatory needed after forgiveness?
title.fr: Pourquoi le purgatoire après le pardon des péchés ?

source.locus: Salzano manuscript Q272–293; 1905 Catechismo maggiore Q776–790
source.studyProposition: Q99 distinguishes remaining debts of punishment and Q101 explains purification before seeing God.

title.en: What was your family life in Riese like?
title.fr: Que sait-on de la vie familiale de Giuseppe Sarto à Riese ?

source.studyProposition: Parents, siblings and household context documented; source does not supply Sarto's first-person memories.

title.en: How did your parents influence your early faith?
title.fr: Comment sa famille a-t-elle contribué à sa première éducation religieuse ?

source.studyProposition: Religious household and parish observance documented; degree of each parent's personal influence not independently attested as his testimony.

title.en: What drew you toward the priesthood as a boy?
title.fr: Que sait-on des premiers signes de sa vocation sacerdotale ?

source.studyProposition: Childhood prayer at Cendrole and early vocation reported; specific internal motive is not authorial testimony.

title.en: What did you learn during your seminary years?
title.fr: Que fit Giuseppe Sarto au séminaire de Padoue ?

source.studyProposition: Courses, musical activity, leadership and grades documented; not a firsthand reflection on what he learnt.

title.en: What did serving in Tombolo teach you about souls?
title.fr: Quel fut son premier ministère à Tombolo ?

source.studyProposition: Pastoral service documented; supposed lessons inferred from this period would be invented in first person.

title.en: What was your work as parish priest in Salzano?
title.fr: Que faisait-il comme curé de Salzano ?

source.studyProposition: Parish appointment, intensive pastoral work and service documented; specific daily duties require fuller biography.

title.en: How did serving in the diocesan curia shape your ministry?
title.fr: Quelles charges occupa-t-il à la curie de Trévise ?

source.studyProposition: Chancellor, seminary director and canon roles attested; personal formative impact not quoted.

title.en: What challenges awaited you as Bishop of Mantua?
title.fr: Quels défis rencontra-t-il comme évêque de Mantoue ?

source.studyProposition: Difficult diocesan and state relations, Christian renewal, and social initiatives described as later biography.

title.en: What did you seek to accomplish as Patriarch of Venice?
title.fr: Que réalisa-t-il comme patriarche de Venise ?

source.studyProposition: Patriarchal appointment and social initiatives documented; precise first-person intention awaits primary letters.

title.en: What distinguishes authentic doctrinal development from changing dogma?
title.fr: Comment distinguer le développement de la doctrine d'un changement de la vérité révélée ?

source.studyProposition: Rejects changeable dogmatic formulae in Modernist account; positive rules for legitimate doctrinal development need other sources.

title.en: How should faith and scientific inquiry be reconciled?
title.fr: Comment la foi et la recherche scientifique doivent-elles se rencontrer ?

source.studyProposition: Critiques subordination of faith to science and discusses sacred/profane study; general reconciliation requires a second constructive locus.

title.en: What should Catholics do when false teaching spreads among clergy?
title.fr: Que faire lorsque des erreurs doctrinales se répandent parmi les clercs ?

source.studyProposition: Direct prescriptions primarily address bishops and clergy, not every action lay Catholics should take in allegations against clergy.

title.en: What principles should guide Catholics facing hostile state legislation?
title.fr: Quels principes retenir face à une loi d'État hostile à l'Église ?

source.studyProposition: Historically specific Catholic response to French law; not a timeless rule for all contemporary jurisdictions.

title.en: Can the Church teach ancient dogmas in genuinely new circumstances?
title.fr: L'Église peut-elle enseigner les anciens dogmes dans des circonstances nouvelles ?

source.studyProposition: Rejects dogma's variable truth; does not exhaust legitimate applications to new circumstances.

title.en: What does participation in the Church's common prayer require?
title.fr: En quoi consiste la participation à la prière publique de l'Église ?

source.studyProposition: Active participation in liturgy and public prayer is named, but exact practical behaviors require further sources.

title.en: How should children be prepared for their first Holy Communion?
title.fr: Comment préparer les enfants à leur première communion ?

source.studyProposition: Calls for apt illustrations and instruction before First Communion; sacramental age/precise readiness also requires Quam singulari (1910).

title.en: How should Catholic parents respond when public schools provide no religious instruction?
title.fr: Que faire si l'école publique n'enseigne pas la religion ?

source.studyProposition: Proposes religious classes for pupils in secular schools, not a full parent-specific course of action.

title.en: Can repentance be genuine when I repeatedly fall?
title.fr: Le repentir peut-il être sincère quand on retombe dans ses fautes ?

source.studyProposition: Sorrow, purpose of amendment and occasions are present, but repeated falls as such are a distinct pastoral question.

title.en: Can truthfully revealing a fault harm reputation?
title.fr: Une révélation véridique peut-elle léser injustement la réputation ?

source.studyProposition: Q206 mentions detraction and unjust injury to reputation, Q208 reparation; justified disclosure requires more detail than these answers alone.

title.en: Why are hatred and bad example serious sins?
title.fr: Pourquoi la haine et le mauvais exemple sont-ils de graves fautes ?

source.studyProposition: Q198–199 address bad example/scandal and Q200 enemies; the exact distinction between emotions of anger and deliberate hatred is not fully answered.

title.en: What do children owe parents and where does obedience end?
title.fr: Quels devoirs les enfants ont-ils envers leurs parents ?

source.studyProposition: The full Italian answers prescribe obedience to parents and superiors, but do not expressly state the limit for immoral orders; obtain Salzano's explicit qualification.

editorialRule: Partial witnesses only support the narrow proposition. Biography is third-person narrator text; app must not display it as simulated Pius X speech.
witnessCaution: Original 1905 longer Catechism and Salzano passages are research-located; cross-links to the online 1912 transcription are independent digital witnesses and remain uncollated against historic print.
